name: @w6w-apps/clientify
description: Manage contacts, companies, deals, tasks and notes in Clientify CRM.

w6w.longDescription:
Clientify is a CRM and marketing-automation platform popular with small and mid-sized businesses in Spain and Latin America. This app covers the core CRM surface of its v1 REST API: list, search, create, update and delete contacts, companies and deals; add notes and tags; close a deal as won or lost; create and complete tasks; and read the account's users, deal pipelines (with their stages) and task types so a workflow can resolve the ids and URLs those calls need.

Authentication is the account API key, sent as `Authorization: Token <key>`. A health check tracks Clientify's own status page for the V1 API components (the app only calls /v1), and a second check confirms the API host is answering without spending a credential. Clientify documents no rate limit or usage endpoint, so quota headroom is declared unavailable rather than guessed.
